formatDate.name: formatDate
formatDate.implementation: const date = new Date(args[0]); return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' })

getProperty.name: getProperty
getProperty.implementation: const properties = utils.loadProperties('example.properties'); const key = args[0] + '.' + args[1]; return utils.getProperty(properties, key, '[Not Found]')
